build_arena_with_default_xml: build an Arena instance that loads the default composer arena MJCF XML file
build_arena_with_custom_xml: build an Arena instance with a custom XML path and optional model name
add_free_entity_to_arena: add a free-moving entity to the arena by attaching it with a freejoint
get_arena_mjcf_model: get the MJCF root model from an Arena instance via the mjcf_model property
review_arena_class: review the Arena class and its _build method for custom arena configuration
